rules.message: An unmitigated hazard requires a hold and supervisor escalation.
Resolve the safety hold before any other closure disposition.
Verify this work order and premises identity, or record a hold.
Stage acceptance requires adequate recorded access / permissions.
Complete the required reinstatement acceptance before completed provision.
A service-live answer needs end-to-end fibre, optical and operational evidence for final provision.
A blocked route cannot be recorded as a live service.
The dependent build stage needs an accepted design; otherwise record a hold.
Completed installation requires explicit access / permission.
New entry requires explicit consent; record a hold if consent is absent.
Confirm that the attached evidence is sufficient and linked to this work order.
Confirm a safe site handover or record a hold.
Only final provision may be recorded as completed customer service.
Completed provision requires verified ont fitted.
Completed provision requires verified fibre connected.
Completed provision requires verified optical test.
Completed provision requires verified operational test.
Completed provision requires verified service live.
Completed provision requires verified customer handover.
Completed provision requires verified location agreed.
Completed provision requires verified external connection.
Completed provision requires verified internal fibre.
Completed provision requires verified ont status checked.
Outstanding work must be handed over; do not mark it completed.
An obstructed route cannot close as service live.
An alternative terminal needs explicit authorisation before completed provision.
Resolve the asset mismatch or refer it to the network owner.
Inform the customer that the service is not live.
Unapproved wayleave blocks the dependent build stage; record a hold.
Use the final provision workflow for a live service closure.
Civils stage acceptance requires civils to design.
Civils stage acceptance requires reinstatement accepted.
Civils stage acceptance requires as built accepted.
Fibre stage completion requires accepted segment tests.
Stage completion requires an accepted downstream handoff.
Resolve outstanding work for this stage or record a partial / referral.
Design stage completion requires recorded acceptance.
Distribution completion requires a verified terminal mapping.
Network readiness requires all network stages accepted.
Network readiness requires fibre placed spliced.
Network readiness requires splice tests accepted.
Network readiness requires terminal available mapped.
Network readiness requires as built accepted.
Network readiness requires premises ready.
Network readiness requires downstream handoff.
